purpose: Independently labeled endpoint sample for evaluating whether a reality signal (currently the ASM decoy / soft-404 comparison) can separate real routes from discovery phantoms without demoting real endpoints. Labels are ground truth derived from the target application's known route structure, NEVER from the probe result being evaluated (that would be circular).

label_values.real: A distinct server-addressable endpoint of the application.
label_values.phantom: Not a distinct endpoint: a wordlist/synthesized path that the server may still answer.
label_values.client_route: Resolved in the browser, not server-addressable. Must NOT be judged phantom.
label_values.unknown: Genuinely ambiguous; a correct classifier may answer unknown.

notes: A binary real/phantom verdict is known to be insufficient: an auth middleware can answer a real protected route and a nonexistent one identically, and HTTP permits 404 for an existing forbidden resource. Entries whose correct outcome is 'unknown' are included deliberately so an evaluator is scored on abstention, not only on separation.
